creator: griffybit
statement: Version 1.8 patch brings the Rift end game content, shiny pets buffs and a giveaway announcement.

creator: griffybit
statement: Shiny pets were already unlockable but now have a buff that hugely boosts your account.

creator: griffybit
statement: Buy the Paint Bucket upgrade with gray DNA at breeding level 40 to unlock the ability to attempt shiny pets.

creator: griffybit
statement: Shiny comes in five colors but colors are cosmetic only; all shinies are the same.

creator: griffybit
statement: Put shiny pets into the fence yard to level their perk; see the buff in the special tab.

creator: griffybit
statement: Each shiny has its own special perk and levels up by time spent in the fence yard.

creator: griffybit
statement: Multiple copies of the same shiny in fence yard speed progress; six shiny spores give six days of progress per day.

creator: griffybit
statement: Shiny buffs include base stats, shiny speed, total damage percent, meal effect percent and more.

creator: griffybit
statement: Level green spore, wooden board, crescent spud and quenches shiny first because they give shiny speed, reducing time to level other shinies.

creator: griffybit
statement: iOS can now officially link to Steam accounts so Steam-blocked achievements can be obtained.

creator: griffybit
statement: Gem shop has a pricey Rift Walker bundle with cool wings.

creator: griffybit
statement: New cosmetic name tag item; OZO rewards staff hats as well.

creator: griffybit
statement: Reach the octodars map in World 4, take the rope at the right of the map up, and complete the NPC questline to unlock the rift.

creator: griffybit
statement: Rift unlock is account-wide so you only need to do it on one character.

creator: griffybit
statement: Start at Rift stage one; standing on the big rip portal shows the task needed to advance to the next level.

creator: griffybit
statement: Enemies scale each time you go deeper into the rift.

creator: griffybit
statement: Rift tasks range from 1 million AFK kills to 500 kills in a time limit, orb kills, siege breaker, flight, coins etc.

creator: griffybit
statement: Traversing the rift gives upgrades that are very strong.
